key_points: Zacks names BIDU 'Bear of the Day,' citing failure to keep pace with the broader market and a mixed forward outlook.
Alibaba's Zhenwu V900 AI chip launch highlights Baidu's relative inactivity in the AI compute race, raising competitive concerns.
Baidu stock trading near 52-week low, with analysts questioning whether it is a value trap or a recovery candidate.
Bernstein Liebhard LLP shareholder alert signals potential legal or governance overhang.
Multiple negative signals are incremental rather than thesis-shattering; much weakness may already be partially priced in at current levels.
